references.supports: Stanford CS230, recording Lecture 9: Career Advice in AI , 2025-11-18. Andrew Ng’s introduction and Laurence Moroney’s guest talk and Q&A. Matched Ng deck , three pages, and guest deck , thirty pages.

Kwa et al., Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks , March 2025 version 1. PDF pp. 1–2, 9–10, 12 and 15 checked for source identity, task suite, fitted horizon, release-date doubling, success thresholds and the SWE-bench timing-bias caveat. A later July 2026 revision is not used for the lecture's historical figures.

Amdahl, Validity of the Single Processor Approach to Achieving Large Scale Computing Capabilities , 1967 article reprinted in IEEE Solid-State Circuits Newsletter, 2007, pp. 19–20 (both PDF pages checked). Supports the constraint from unaccelerated work. The product-feedback equation here is an original application, not an equation quoted from that article.

Christakis and Fowler, The Collective Dynamics of Smoking in a Large Social Network , New England Journal of Medicine 358 (2008), 2249–2258. The authors' publisher-formatted PDF, p. 1 (journal p. 2249), supports the smoking clusters in the studied longitudinal network. It supplies no study of hard-working friends or career success.

Shalizi and Thomas, Homophily and Contagion Are Generically Confounded in Observational Social Network Studies , 2011 journal publication, preprint PDF pp. 1–3 checked. Supports the distinction between observed clustering and identified influence when latent traits affect relationships and behaviour.

Cunningham, The WyCash Portfolio Management System , OOPSLA 1992 experience report. Complete short original HTML checked for the debt metaphor and consolidation of understanding. It supplies no numerical software-interest model.

Sculley et al., Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems , 2015, PDF pp. 1 and 4 checked. Supports system-level maintenance dependencies and feedback risks, not a measured generated-versus-handwritten-code comparison.

Yao et al., ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models , ICLR 2023, PDF pp. 1–2 checked. Supports interleaving reasoning, actions and observations; no benchmark percentage is imported into the sales example.

Shinn et al., Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning , 2023, PDF pp. 1–2 checked. Supports feedback retained as text without weight updates and the absence of a formal guarantee. It does not validate the lecture's pilot.

Google, A new era of intelligence with Gemini 3 , 2025-11-18. The dated official announcement corroborates the calendar remark through its opening release statements. No current model-quality, price or safety claim is inferred.

Arm, Part 1: Arm Scalable Matrix Extension (SME) Introduction , Zenon (Zhilong) Xiu, 2024-05-23. Its architecture overview, ZA array and instruction sections support matrix storage and outer-product operations. No complete-device benchmark or power claim is imported.
